zlib-ng 2.2.2 (https://github.com/zlib-ng/zlib-ng, tag 2.2.2), as Halo 1 Unlimited's installer uses it
=====================================================================================================

The installer (port/oxbox/installer: ngz.c, nxdk.mk) uses zlib-ng's native API (zng_ names, beside nxdk's own zlib) for
the stock maps swap: deflate at level 2 for the small maps, inflate for every map it reads. The restore still recompresses
with zlib 1.3.1, which alone gives the retail maps' exact bytes.

This is a subset of the release, altered as the zlib License asks to be marked:
- Only the generic C code: the root's .c and .h files without gz*.c, gzguts.h, compress.c, uncompr.c, infback.c and
  cpu_features.c, and arch/generic. No other arch/ folders (the Xbox's Pentium III has no SSE2 or later).
- zlib-ng.h is the one CMake generates (ZLIB_COMPAT off: the @ZLIB_SYMBOL_PREFIX@ markers gone), zconf-ng.h is
  zconf-ng.h.in, and zlib_name_mangling-ng.h is zlib_name_mangling.h.empty.
- zconf-ng.h: <sys/types.h> isn't included when NXDK is defined (nxdk has none; nothing used needs off_t). Marked there.
- Built with DISABLE_RUNTIME_CPU_DETECTION (straight to the generic functions); see nxdk.mk for the rest.
